# A zypper install without -y or --no-confirm blocks on confirmation.
# Ok lines come first: the -y/--no-confirm exclusions span forward otherwise.
# ok: missing-zypper-no-confirm-switch
RUN zypper install -y nginx
# ok: missing-zypper-no-confirm-switch
RUN zypper install --no-confirm curl
# ruleid: missing-zypper-no-confirm-switch
RUN zypper install nginx
# ruleid: missing-zypper-no-confirm-switch
RUN zypper install curl wget
